name: Thaumaturgical Rituals — Intermediate — Mark of Amaranth

system.description: By personally destroying a Kindred and placing a possession of your intended victim into the corpse before it crumbles, you cause that victim to register as a diablerist to any form of divination — Aura Perception, the Blood Walk ritual, or similar scrying — until the next sunrise, regardless of the victim's actual innocence.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
